novelty.justification: The claim's core route is a new mechanistic relationship and measurement target: it asks whether models "encode these balance relationships as coupled directions" and reproduce the "latitude-dependent breakdown of geostrophic balance near the equator," rather than merely decoding physical fields. The closest prior work I found was the 2025 GraphCast SAE study, which identifies and intervenes on individual physical features, together with Pangu-Weather dynamical/​Matsuno–Gill perturbation studies and the 2025 ocean study using a latitude-weighted geostrophic output constraint; searches using "weather model internal representation geostrophic balance," "GraphCast mechanistic interpretability balance," "Pangu-Weather geostrophic adjustment," "latitude-dependent geostrophic breakdown neural network," and "physics-informed weather model geostrophic constraint" did not reveal an equivalent internal relational test. The step from those works to this claim is a new core relationship—causal coupling of internal wind and pressure-gradient representations with an f-dependent equatorial signature—not a direct transfer, although the proposed probes, CCA, and interventions are standard tools and do not constitute a new general-purpose method, supporting a 7 rather than an 8–10.
